newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Syndicate formed for Dfl 2.25 bln Dutch PTT credit.
newsitem.headline: Syndicate formed for Dfl 2.25 bln Dutch PTT credit.

text.p: Post and telecommunications group Koninklijke PTT Nederland (KPN) said on Friday a banking syndicate had been set up for its 2.25 billion guilders credit facility which was announced last month.

Citibank International plc and Goldman Sachs International were appointed as joint arrangers and joint syndication agents for the facility, which will finance KPN's intended takeover of Australia's TNT Ltd.
Dutch ABN AMRO was appointed facility agent.
The banking syndicate further consists of Commonwealth Bank of Australia, Dresdner Bank, Generale Bank, ING, JP Morgan, RABO, SBC Warburg and UBS.
The margin over LIBOR has been fixed at 10 basis points.
KPN said syndication to a wider group of banks will be launched within the next few weeks
